explanation.headline: Not on FDA's shortage list; FDA's record shows actions at plants on our labels

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows metoprolol succinate is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 161 tablets of the 25 mg presentation at 8.6 tablets per day, providing 18.7 days on hand, and also holds 264 tablets at 13.6 per day for 19.4 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 393 tablets at 13.8 per day for 28.5 days on hand, and 305 tablets at 13.7 per day for 22.3 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Actavis Pharma, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.
Secondary options include Advagen Pharma Limited and Advagen Pharma Ltd., also not on the shortage list, with no plant identified on their labels.

rejected.text: Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. posted a discontinuation for metoprolol succinate extended-release tablets on 2026-08-31, citing a business decision to discontinue manufacture.
Metoprolol succinate is not on FDA's shortage list; Teva posted a discontinuation on 2026-08-31 and our sites hold 18.7 to 28.5 days on hand

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-1a44d6.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('68071396309', '71335974508')
